title: Daande Teeminanɗe ɗe Heɗtaaka
intro: E jamaanu ɓooyɗo hade gure mawɗe umminde, ruuhu gooto ummiima e nder leñol ngol ruttii e goonga. Tiiɗnaare maɓɓe hawri tan ko e muñal oo nodduɗo gooto, ñaagotooɗo e nder yontaaji tawa ronkaani pellital. Nde jeertinaango fof yani e noppi muusɗi, hiisa mo meeɗaa yiyeede, wayli sifaa leydi ndii e hoore mum. Hannde, ƴoƴre ndeen daartol ina ɓuuɓtoo haa jooni e kala jaŋngugol. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude ooɗoo ruuhu tiiɗɗo?
clues: Mi ummiima e leñol rewooɓe sanamuuji fenaande, ɓe njejjitaani maandeeji taariiɗi ɗum en, tee mi suɓaama ngam umminde ɓe e majjere maɓɓe.
Mi noddii leñol am laabi keewɗi, kono ɓe tuumi mi wonde mi wonaa neɗɗo hono maɓɓe, ina ƴattoo nulal am ina sudda noppi maɓɓe.
Jamma e ñalawma, miɗo ñaagoo ɓe hakkille e siftorde newaare, kono konngol am ina wayi no majjii e weeyo, ngol nanaaka, ngol heɗaaka.
E nder yamiroore Alla, mi mahii laana mawka, leɗɗe e leɗɗe e dow leydi njoorndi, leñol am ina jalee kam no neɗɗo majjuɗo hakkille nii.
Nde ilam mawɗam ɗam ari no fodirnoo nii, ɓiɗɗo am oo salii naatde e am e laana kaa, sibu ina sikki koɗorɗe ina mbaawi daɗndude ɗum e ndiyam ummotooɗam ɗam.
Mi wonti baaba fuɗɗoode hesere dow leydi, daartol am ina reeni e nder deftere Qur’aana jogiinde innde am tigi.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
verse: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day. (71:5)
